Use case: illustration-story. Transform the first input, a newly authored original 3D scene guide, into original finished comic art. Input 1 controls camera, composition, placements and contact; input 2 is a newly generated original cast reference controlling adult identities and economical ink/cel drawing, NOT poses. Do not reproduce extra reference studies or robots/mannequins. Nera is a31-year-old lean female courier with warm brown skin, mature long angular face, short black curls, straw-yellow asymmetric rain cape, charcoal practical clothes and boots. Odo is a38-year-old broad male keeper with tan skin, cropped silver hair, ultramarine work jacket and cream cuffs. Both are fictional mature adults, no real likeness. Deliberate energetic tapered ink, appealing adult faces, controlled broad two-tone shadows, sharp silhouettes, motivated expressive posture. Palette: warm ivory stone, cool slate shadows, charcoal ink, straw cape, ultramarine jacket and violet threat slit; tiny cyan braking accents only where required. No global sepia, dense distressed textures, fog, spark clouds, photorealism, glossy3D, decorative armor or generic ornamental detail. Keep action contact and faces clear. No lettering, captions, SFX words, UI, symbols resembling writing, watermark, page borders or balloons. Preserve all story events and object ownership. No named artist, comic or franchise imitation.

Canvas aspect ratio 1170:900; match the full guide frame and normalized actor placements.
PANEL P09. The sentinel pivots around the very same restrained forefoot while its separate side leg sweeps left toward Odo at the west release. Nera keeps both boots on the dry ridge and braces the ONE intact staff against that fixed foot; one capped flask is upright in her chest sling. Odo has one hand on the west cord and his other hand free. The east shutter is closed. Exactly three sentinel limbs: anchored foreleg, leftward sweeping side leg, rear supporting leg. Do not turn the sweep into a fourth appendage. No injury yet.

Output ONLY the two adult CHARACTER LAYERS on a genuinely transparent background, with the exact same full canvas and exact actor placements/scale/hand and foot positions as the first guide. Preserve the empty space around them; do not crop/center/enlarge them. Draw expressive natural adult anatomy in the guide poses. Include their clothes, hands, faces and hair; include the small right-hand abrasion only in P13/P14. OMIT ALL environment, water, monster, staff, bottle, rope, floor, shadows on the floor, arrows and motion effects. These are separately composited fixed editable scene/prop layers. Hands still form the exact shown grips/support gestures; empty grips are deliberate compositing inputs. The guide threat and props show interaction geometry only; never include them in this transparent character output. No white/colored/checkerboard background.
